unfiltered.query: What time do minions report for the morning briefing?
unfiltered.answer: Minions report for the morning briefing at 7:30am, according to gru-minion-handbook-v1 §2 Daily Operations / Morning Briefing.

retrieved_chunks.text:
Report at 7:30am. Wear goggles. Bring your own banana. Gru speaks first. Dr. Nefario speaks second if something is on fire. If Gru is still in his robe, wait.
The briefing names the target, the vehicle, and today's duty. Banana duty means you do not touch the freeze ray. Lab duty means you do not open the vault. Child watch means you do not mention world domination in front of the girls.
Late minions stand in the back.

Late minions stand in the back. Two late arrivals in one week means you mop the garage. The mop is returned.

This handbook is for minions assigned to Gru's house, lab, and lair. It covers daily duty, equipment, bananas, and what to do when a plan fails. Read it before your first shift. Keep one copy in your pocket. Version 2.0 replaces Version 1.0. If the two books disagree, follow this one.
Gru's work changes from week to week. Some weeks the team builds a freeze ray. Some weeks the team babysits. The rules in this book stay the same. A minion who follows it is useful.

Count these items at the start of the shift. Say the count out loud so the minion on the log can write it. Missing gear goes in the log before you eat. Do not wait until after the smoothie.
Item | Location | Count
Freeze ray | Rack A | 1
Shrink ray | Cabinet B | 1
Safety goggles | Hook wall | 24
Red collection bin | Under bench 3 | 2
If the freeze ray count is zero, stop all other work and find Gru. If the goggle count is under twenty, no new minions enter the floor.

retrieved_chunks.text: The moon-door password is PURPLE-KAZOO-9. Say it once at the steel hatch. Do not write it on a banana.
The moon door is welded shut. Minions use the garage ramp. Do not knock. Do not wait at that door.

If the house alarm sounds, take the girls to the orange couch. Close the vault. Hide the plans. Get Gru.
If a girl is already in the lab, walk her out. Do not hand her a gadget. Do not ask her to hold a flask. Fire, flood, and visitors at the door are get-Gru events. Do not let Vector in for a cookie.
When in doubt, find Gru, keep the girls safe, and leave the unicorns where you can count them.

This manual is for minions working on the lab floor. It does not replace Gru's field handbook. The lab has its own doors, keys, and rules. Read it before you touch a beaker. Keep one copy on the hook by the yellow door.
Only assigned lab minions may enter after 8am. Child watch stays upstairs. Banana duty stays in the kitchen. If you are not on the daily lab list, wait in the hallway. Do not lean on the yellow door. Do not knock with a wrench.
